title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 2B: Objects and numbers
subtitle: Common objects and numbers 1–90 from 2B

words.def: big printed pages with the news of the day
words.sent: I read the ___ every morning.

words.def: you use it to call people and send messages
words.sent: Can I use your ___? I want to call my mum.

words.def: pages with a story or information to read
words.sent: I have a ___ in my bag — it’s a good story.

words.def: you hold it over your head when it rains
words.sent: It’s raining. Do you have an ___?

words.def: water in a plastic or glass container
words.sent: I’m thirsty. I have a ___ in my bag.

words.def: you use it to open a door
words.sent: I can’t open the door. Where’s my ___?

words.def: a machine for work, the internet and email
words.sent: I work on my ___ all day.

words.def: you use it to cut food
words.sent: Can I have a ___? I want to cut the bread.

words.def: a piece of paper you need for a train, plane or cinema
words.sent: Here’s my plane ___. I go to London today.

words.def: a small clock you wear on your arm
words.sent: What’s the time? — I don’t know. I don’t have a ___.

words.def: you carry your things in it
words.sent: What’s in your ___? — A book and my keys.
